Chandler North Saturday Ride

Chandler, AZ

Chandler North Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Chandler, AZ. It meets every Saturday, meet 5:45 am, roll 6:00 am, starting at Global Bikes & E-Bikes Chandler. Expect about 30–50 miles, A 22+ mph, B 18+ mph, C 15+ mph.

About the Chandler North Saturday Ride group ride

A Saturday shop ride with three pace groups. The C group holds a steady 15 mph and keeps the group together. Faster groups go longer. RSVP on the shop's Meetup, which has over 5,000 members.
